text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"\"7 years at Microsoft\" vs \"5 years of software development experience at Meta\"","dimension":"seniority","description":"This captures the overall depth of professional experience and time spent in relevant engineering roles.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"launching 2 of them\" vs \"launch of 4 production services\"","dimension":"product launch scope","description":"This captures how much direct experience the applicant claims with shipping production systems.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"Master's degree\" vs \"Doctoral degree\"","dimension":"academic credential level","description":"This captures the highest formal degree mentioned and the apparent academic depth of preparation.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I automated my team's vulnerability report handling\" vs \"designed and delivered automation for vulnerability report triage\"","dimension":"security automation ownership","description":"This captures the extent to which the applicant presents hands-on ownership of automating security workflows.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"queue went from a dreaded chore to something the tooling mostly runs itself\" vs \"materially reducing the manual handling previously required\"","dimension":"impact framing","description":"This captures how concretely the letter quantifies or emphasizes the operational impact of past work.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"The tinkering never stopped either; my latest small side build is a command-line habit trcker\" vs \"CompTIA Security+ certification\"","dimension":"extracurricular security signal","description":"This captures the presence of explicit outside-the-job evidence of technical or security-oriented initiative.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"regularly send patches upstream\" vs \"compete in capture-the-flag security competitions\"","dimension":"open-source or competition evidence","description":"This captures whether the applicant shows continued engagement through external technical communities or contests.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I am drawn to teams whose success shows up as reliability felt across an entire company\" vs \"The team's remit of strengthening security across the entire development lifecycle corresponds closely with my professional interests\"","dimension":"motivation specificity","description":"This captures how directly and explicitly the letter ties personal motivation to the team and role.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"building the systems that keep everyone else's systems trustworthy\" vs \"responsible for internal services and automation used across my current organization\"","dimension":"organizational breadth of contribution","description":"This captures whether the applicant emphasizes impact on many teams or a broader organizational scope.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"maintainer's mindset\" and \"inherited services alive\" vs \"working habits are well matched\"","dimension":"maintenance orientation","description":"This captures the emphasis on sustaining, debugging, and inheriting systems rather than only building new ones.","winner":"A"}]}
